besatt.name: Overrun
besatt.desc: Monsters everywhere, black mist, not a living soul.

rensad.name: Cleansed
rensad.desc: The town's boss is slain and every zone cleared at least once. No monsters will ever rise here again.

handlare.desc: Buys and sells potions and common goods.

vapenhandlare.desc: Buys and sells weapons, armor and shields. Never alters an item.

vakter.desc: Town guards hold off raids. No monsters spawn near town.

kuriosahandlare.desc: Buys and sells finer amulets, rings and bone goods. Never alters an item.

helare.desc: Heals for free and cures poison.

gamla_byn.name: The Old Village
gamla_byn.access: The Red Portal at the heart of the forest. Opens when all three runes are awake.

kopparberg.name: Copperfell
kopparberg.access: The road north through the mountains. Always open.

askeborg.name: Ashenhold
askeborg.access: The road south across the Ash Fields. Always open.
